items.title: [QUESTION] Best app to learn chords, scales, keys, theory, etc. as a nonbeginner? Condensed information?
items.text:
[QUESTION] Best app to learn chords, scales, keys, theory, etc. as a nonbeginner? Condensed information?
Looking for an app that can help me learn beyond tabs. I've learned to play a variety of popular fingerstyle songs and have begun trying out acoustic percussion, but it feels so empty without knowing what is really going on behind just basic muscle memory.

Most apps are guitar for beginners and I have to click through tons of useless screens, pages, steps, etc. to find just the basic explanation, and the information is usually in multiple pages making it harder to try to cement into my memory. Not sure if there's an app, website, book, etc on this that is more condensed, but I'd love to hear about it.

I'd prefer to be able to view it on my phone in an app or even a mobile friendly website, as most of my time is spent in bed as of late, but I'm more than appreciative of any suggestions anyone might have to help me on this.
